name: Smart-Hostel-Student-System
description: A full stack hostel management portal with student registration, OTP verified email, digital ID cards, leave/complaint tracking, and a multi hostel admin panel.

paragraphs: A production web portal for hostel students to register, log in, and manage their own records with a full Admin panel to manage two hostels' data, approvals, leave requests, complaints, notices, and gallery, kept completely separate per hostel.

Built for Einstein Academy of Technology and Management, this system covers two hostels Main Boys Hostel and E-Block Hostel with fully independent data, approvals, and notices per hostel, managed through a single Admin account.
features: Home — hostel photo, college info, Student Login and Admin Login entry points
Student Registration — full profile form with email verification via a 6-digit OTP before submission
Notice Board — combined notices from both hostels, tagged by hostel
Contact — warden name, phone, and email per hostel
